**Step 3 — Items:** Fresh rolls with pale vegetable/protein filling; rice-and-nori sushi with vegetable and pale protein filling; mixed fruit including melon, grapes, pineapple, and strawberries; soy sauce; wasabi. Exact fillings are uncertain; no separate oil is visible.
